correctness.rationale: Let h count line-only triples, c=6−h conic-containing triples. Bézout with precisely three tangent lines yields 2(h−3) conic-line nodes; six lines have 15 pair intersections so h is 3 or 4 (h=5 impossible by incidence parity). For h=4, four line triples force complete-quadrangle incidence with three disjoint residual pairs; two conic-containing triples occupy four lines, leaving only two available for three tangent lines, a contradiction. Hence h=c=3 and no conic-line nodes; the three secants are a triangle with its vertices on the smooth conic, and three pairwise tangent intersections lie one each on its three secants. Normalize secants to coordinate lines and smooth conic to Q=xy+xz+yz. Distinct tangent parameters s,t,u satisfy 2st+s+t=0, s+u=0, t+u+2=0; algebra gives u=−s, t=s−2 and s²−s−1=0. The coordinate swap x↔z induces v↦1/v and exchanges the two roots; hence a single unlabelled PGL₃(C) orbit. Independently verified the exact tangent-pair elimination with SymPy; read both packaged geometry and classification checkers and their symbolic incidence logic. Near-freeness is inherited from the earlier exact arrangement existence, not claimed independently.
